summary.en-US: Play HLS (.m3u8) streams directly in Firefox instead of downloading them.

description.en-US: HLS Player intercepts top-level HTTP Live Streaming (.m3u8) navigations and opens them in a clean local video player. Playback uses Firefox's native HLS support when available and otherwise the bundled hls.js library. The extension has no accounts, analytics, telemetry, remote code, or developer-operated service.

privacy_policy.en-US: HLS Player does not collect or transmit personal data, browsing history, stream URLs, playback information, telemetry, or analytics. Seamless mode, the video-controls preference, and the Display / Ratio preference are stored only in browser.storage.local and are not synchronized or sent to any third party.

version.approval_notes: HTTP/HTTPS host access plus webRequest and webRequestBlocking are required to redirect top-level .m3u8 navigations before Firefox treats them as downloads. The listener is restricted to main_frame requests and .m3u8 pathnames. The storage permission stores only local player preferences: Seamless mode, whether native controls are shown, and the selected Display / Ratio mode. hls.js is pinned in package-lock.json and bundled locally; no remote code is executed. Reproduce with Node.js 24, npm ci, then npm run build.

release_notes.en-US: Adds Display / Ratio modes for Fill, Best fit, Original, Native, 16:9, and 4:3. The settings popup now follows Firefox light/dark appearance and uses a more compact layout.
